note: Temperature assumed 10^6 K (typical magnetosheath). True beta requires FPI temperature product.
interpretation: Low beta (magnetically dominated) corresponds to higher |B|, which Q2 showed correlates with lower associator (Alfvenic coupling). High beta (plasma dominated) has weaker |B| and more compressive fluctuations. The chain: high beta -> weak |B| -> compressive modes -> disrupted phase coupling -> higher associator.
